spec.name: Marcus
spec.archetype: panic-seller who freezes on adverse moves

versions.statement: Marcus initially panics and sells prematurely whenever he encounters a losing trade.
Marcus has learned to stay calm during losing trades and follows his pre-decided strategy instead of selling prematurely.
Marcus aims to better understand market volatility to improve his decision-making process.
Marcus often doubts the validity of his trading strategy when faced with market downturns.
Marcus prefers using technical analysis over fundamental analysis when making trading decisions.
Marcus struggles to manage stress effectively during volatile market conditions.
Marcus has developed effective stress management techniques for better handling market volatility.
Marcus relies heavily on trading signals from external sources to make his trading decisions.
